title: ChatGPT Images 2.0: Multi-Step Reasoning Before Pixels are Rendered
description: OpenAI's ChatGPT Images 2.0 doesn't just map text to pixels—it thinks first. It plans lighting, perspective, and typography before rendering, enabling perfect text rendering on signs and intricate spatial compositions.
pricingDetails: Available on ChatGPT Plus and Team accounts

promptSet.title: Flawless Typography & Composition Visual Prompt
promptSet.description:
Prompt 1:
Freeform fashion-editorial collage of me in 8 distinct full-body summer outfits, arranged organically on a clean cream studio background. Keep my face consistent across all 8 looks, and make my proportions read around 5'10" tall without mentioning height in the text. Add neat handwritten arrows and labels for the key clothing pieces. No grid, border, or boxed panels. Keep all 8 full-body figures at the same visual scale and camera distance. Arrange them in a balanced two-row layout. Use a portrait 2:3 composition.

Prompt 2:
Create using uploaded image. A moody, artistic portrait wearing a crisp white shirt, standing still amidst swirling motion blur. Dramatic neon lighting — cool cyan streaks on one side blending into deep red on the other. Cinematic and surreal contrast. Thoughtful expression, soft focus blur, dreamlike introspective quality. Futuristic yet intimate environment.

Prompt 3:
Create a moody aesthetic blurry mysterious portrait of my picture. Change the background to a plain wall. Warm golden hour sunlight casting dramatic shadow of my face on the wall — shadow clearly visible. Ratio 9:16. Overall cinematic tone

Prompt 4:
Create a hyper-realistic neo-noir portrait of this person in the driver's seat of a car at night. Deep blue and magenta neon lighting illuminates the interior. Rain streaks across the car window. The subject grips the steering wheel with a serious, shadowed expression. Shot through the car window with shallow depth of field. High contrast, cinematic photography. Add subtle text at the bottom: 'IN THE NIGHT' in elegant sans-serif. Ultra-realistic, 9:16 vertical format.

Prompt 5:
Transform this photo into a 35mm analog film portrait. Fujifilm Pro 400H color grading — warm highlights, slightly desaturated shadows, visible film grain. Soft natural light from a window on the left. Candid, intimate framing. No digital sharpening. No airbrushing. Authentic film aesthetic.

Prompt 6:
Transform this casual portrait into a professional headshot suitable for LinkedIn or corporate use. Soft flattering lighting, improve skin tone naturally, smooth minor imperfections subtly. Replace background with a clean neutral studio backdrop. Enhance the outfit to look professional — blazer, dress shirt. Polished, high-resolution, business-ready.

Prompt 7:
Transform this photo into a Studio Ghibli–inspired illustration. Soft pastel colors, hand-painted textures, gentle lighting reminiscent of classic Ghibli films. Dreamy backgrounds, subtle atmospheric details like drifting clouds or light rays, warm nostalgic mood. Keep the main subject recognizable but stylized with expressive features and delicate outlines.

Prompt 8:
Surreal cinematic close-up shot of this person's upper body and face as they float mid-air in their bedroom, head tilted back slightly, glowing headphones radiating light bursts and shimmering artifacts. White linen shirt drifts in slow-motion folds. Books, paper, and a smartphone hover nearby in surreal zero-gravity. Background softly blurred with faint moonlight rays through the window. Chromatic aberration, heavy film grain, glowing contours, motion blur streaks, soft bloom, lens flares

Prompt 9:
Make an old-school golden age Hollywood movie poster using the uploaded photo. Movie title: '[YOUR NAME]: The Documentary'. Change the costume to fit the 1950s era. Directorial credit at the bottom. Dramatic lighting, film grain, vintage poster typography. Cinematic and epic tone.

Prompt 10:
Transform this portrait into a 3D plastic action figure inside a collector's toy box packaging. Include my name as the figure name on the box label. Box text: 'Limited Edition — [Your Name] Figure'. Accessories listed on the side panel matching my personality. Photorealistic product photography style, studio lighting, clean white background.
instructions: Open ChatGPT and choose the newest image generation pipeline.
Specify exact text strings within quotes for accurate sign rendering.
Enjoy crisp, legible typography on packaging, signs, and apparel.
promptSet.exampleOutput: Photorealistic Tokyo coffee shop with perfectly rendered, sharp gold lettering on the sign.
